# Adrian Treleaven

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ontario  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Journalist, author, and magazine short story writer  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v4 c24 P27](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0027), [v5 c2 P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067)</sub>

## Appearance

Adrian is a tall, broad-shouldered, and handsome man with dense brown hair, a sharp nose and chin, and well-shaped ears. He has luminous, dark-gray eyes that resemble those of his grandmother, Damaris Tremayne, as well as clear teeth that show in an amiable smile. When not smiling, his face carries a somewhat sorrowful and distracted expression.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c23 P9](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0009), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c24 P18](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0018), [v4 c24 P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021)_

## Personality

Adrian is warm, agreeable, and deeply artistic, possessing a keen wit and lively humor. He is an engaging companion who easily wins over others with his charismatic demeanor and appreciation for good food and pleasant company. Intensely devoted to his creative endeavors, he throws his whole heart into writing. He also possesses a deeply emotional and sensitive nature, suffering quietly over matters of love and honoring social boundaries even when distressed.

_Sources: [v4 c22 P33](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0033), [v4 c23 P10](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0010), [v4 c24 P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007), [v4 c25 P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 c25 P13](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0013), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P5](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0005), [v4 c38 P33](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0033)_

- To win the love of Lorna Vane and build a life with her  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)</sub>

## History

After recovering from typhoid, Adrian traveled to Seven Gulls on his doctor's advice to recuperate near the ocean and view his grandparents' original homestead. He stayed as a guest with Lorna Vane and quickly formed a close friendship with Nell Carrow, Dr. Hugh Carrow, and Captain Saul Garrick. Upon discovering Captain Saul's detailed life-book of maritime adventures, Adrian collaborated with him to write a novel based on his life and the tale of lost Margaret. During this summer of creative work and social outings, Adrian fell deeply in love with Lorna, but he kept his feelings secret out of respect for her circumstances until her freedom was clarified. He completed the manuscript in September and returned to Toronto. He later reached out to return for another visit, courting Lorna and eventually becoming engaged to her. Their wedding was set for Christmas, and Adrian purchased the old House of Dreams property from the church trustees for their summer holidays. The publication of their book, *The Life-Book of Captain Saul*, was met with great satisfaction by Captain Saul. Adrian and Lorna later had children, including Damaris and Julian. In a subsequent summer, Adrian took his family to Japan for a year to gather background material for a new novel.

## Background by volume

- He is the grandson of the Glen schoolmaster, John Tremayne, and his wife Damaris  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c24 P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021)</sub>
- His mother was Alice Tremayne, who passed away while he was a young boy  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c24 P22](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0022), [v4 c24 P25](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0025)</sub>
- He lived in Toronto prior to traveling to the coast  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c28 P12](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0012)</sub>
- He survived a severe attack of typhoid in the spring prior to visiting Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>

## Quotes

> The soul will be provided by you and the body by me. Oh, Captain Saul, a renowned book will be authored by the two of us. And our labor will commence immediately.  <sub>[v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)</sub>

> Lorna is loved by me, Mrs. Carrow. LOVED! A word that faint hardly seems sufficient!  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002)</sub>

> Seven Gulls will never see me again, nor will the memory ever leave me  <sub>[v4 c26 P20](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0020)</sub>

> It may be that our own captive endlessness is crying out to the matching endlessness displayed by that seen flawlessness.  <sub>[v4 c26 P24](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0024)</sub>
